title: Migrate agent swarm from Mac to heft
description: Per Mark: move the needful to run the swarm on heft. Steps: (1) opencode on heft up to date; (2) copy auth.json + global opencode config + tui config from Mac, verify a model call works; (3) transfer Mac main (scripts, plugins, round-file mechanism) via git bundle; preserve heft checkout debris on a backup branch; (4) seed heft canonical .beads store from Mac; (5) parameterize launcher worktree base for heft paths; (6) soft-landing round prompt so Mac workers finish current bead then stop claiming; (7) cutover: after Mac fleet drains, kill Mac windows, final .beads sync, launch heft fleet. Mac keeps bench + interactive role.
close_reason: heft side fully staged: opencode 1.18.25 + auth/configs copied and model call verified; main fast-forwarded to Mac canonical via bundle (heft debris preserved on heft-wip-backup branch); shared beads store seeded (3288 issues readable via BEADS_DIR); launcher syntax + path logic validated (tmux present, worktree base resolves to ~/Developer/lichen-workers). Mac workers received stand-down orders. Cutover pending Mac fleet drain: kill Mac tmux windows, final .beads rsync, ssh heft launch.
